study: P12B S7 steering figure-of-merit theta sweep (locked S7 extension)
status: PRODUCTION (locked P5 parameter basis; S7 methodology)

definitions.phi_star_deg: argmax over the locked S7 ring sampling phi in linspace(0, 2 pi, 73) of the S7 unsigned group-velocity deviation delta(phi; theta, AR), reduced modulo the empirically verified 90 deg period of the |delta| field, i.e. phi* = (discrete argmax delta) mod 90 in [0, 90) deg; tie-break: smallest representative among values within 1e-12 relative of the maximum
definitions.M_s_deg: M_s(AR) = phi*(90 deg, AR) - phi*(0 deg, AR), on the locked grid
definitions.delta_definition: S7 locked: unsigned angle between v_g = grad_k omega and k, compute_group_velocity_2d, branch 0 (first acoustic branch), central differences h = 1e-4
definitions.sampling: phi = linspace(0, 2 pi, 73) endpoints included (5 deg step; S7 locked)
post_processing: mod-90 deg sector convention for the argmax (exact 180 deg headless periodicity + mirror co-symmetry verified numerically per run; the sector is a reporting convention, not a claimed field period)
3-point parabolic refinement recorded separately as phi_star_refined_deg

solver_calls.assembly: assemble_KM(hx=L, hy=L, ... volume-equivalent semi-axes) -- verbatim S7
